messages:
incbot: Paging priya_oncall: High 5xx rate across eu-west dedicated nodes since 12:12 UTC. Error spike correlates with inter-region NLB flaps. Auto-alert: incident severity P1.
priya_oncall: on it. I see elevated 502/504 across gateway and dedicated pools in eu-west. Reproducible across models and independent of tenant. Adding alex_sre.
alex_sre: looking at logs now. Backend instances healthy, but egress to azure interconnect shows packet loss and retransmits. Traceroute shows hops timing out after our peering edge.
jane_vendor_mgr: tagging Azure contacts and opening escalation. Jane to Azure: we've opened a support escalation for PID-78429 (internal). Customer impact: some Dedicated and Private customers in EU experiencing latency and 502s; hosted API mostly unaffected.
Azure Support (Tim): Thanks for the heads-up. We've received your escalation. Initial signal: a backend fabric flap affecting interconnects in eu-west-1 for some circuits. We're investigating; opening internal case: AZ-INC-8172. Can you share traceroutes and timestamps?
alex_sre: sending pasted traces and packet capture to the Azure case. Key traces: 
```
traceroute to 13.52.10.1 (13.52.10.1), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.0.0.1  0.32 ms  0.21 ms  0.20 ms
 2  *****  12.4 ms  15.7 ms
 3  40.90.2.1  17.1 ms  20.2 ms  18.5 ms
 4  * * *
 5  13.52.10.1  200.3 ms  198.6 ms  199.4 ms
```
Also attaching `tcpdump` snippet showing retransmits at 12:11:42-12:13:10 UTC.
priya_oncall: mitigation suggestion: shift dedicated traffic to eu-north as temporary failover, update route policy to prefer alternative peering. Alex, can you prepare a canary reroute and a rollback plan?
alex_sre: will prepare a canary. Plan: update routing weight on CDN/edge to route 5% traffic to eu-north pool, monitor error rate for 5m, then scale to 50% if stable. Rollback: revert weight and clear BGP community. Command snippet: 
```
# change route preference for canary
infra-cli route update --target=dedicated-eu --peer=eu-north --weight=5 --note="canary-azure-8172"
```
jane_vendor_mgr: notifying account teams and customer success for impacted Dedicated customers. Drafting customer-facing note. Sara, can you prep the customer DM template summarizing impact and next steps?
sara_support: Draft DM ready. Suggest we send two variants: "impacted" and "watching". Impacted DM includes ETA to mitigation and link to status page. Draft below: 
```
Hi <CustomerName>,
We're investigating increased request failures for customers in EU regions. Our mitigation team is performing a rolling traffic reroute to alternate region. We expect partial mitigation within 30–45 minutes. We'll follow up with updates here: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2034506789
Apologies for the disruption — we’ll share remediation and post-incident notes.
-- Redwood Support
```
michael_pm: I'll own the external comms cadence. Can someone post a short status page entry ASAP (initial incident acknowledged) and then update after canary results?
statuspage-bot: New status page incident created: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/2034506789 — Impact: Elevated error rates for Dedicated eu-west. Next update scheduled at 12:30 UTC.
priya_oncall: executing canary reroute now. Alex, kicking off the infra-cli change. I'll monitor SLOs and logs. If error rate drops <1% for 5m, we widen to 50%.
alex_sre: applied canary at 12:18 UTC. Observability: request latency for canary pool currently 220ms; error rate dropping from 8% -> 3% at 12:23.
Azure Support (Tim): We're seeing recovery signals on our fabric. We're rolling a targeted fix; please monitor for residual packet loss. We'll keep the case updated.
priya_oncall: widening to 50% at 12:27 UTC. Watching.
alex_sre: after widening, global 5xx rate down to 0.9% at 12:31. Hosted API unaffected, Dedicated error budget now within tolerance for most customers.
jane_vendor_mgr: good. I'm updating account teams: advising proactive DMs for Tier 1 customers. For others, we'll wait for stabilization and send a follow-up summary.
michael_pm: compose a short status update for customers: 
```
12:32 UTC: Mitigation in progress — we have rolled traffic to alternate EU region and are observing error rates returning to normal for affected Dedicated customers. Azure has applied fixes to the interconnect fabric. We're monitoring. Next update at 13:00 UTC or sooner if conditions change.
```
priya_oncall: handing off to oncall-night for overnight monitoring. Oncall-night, please take over as incident commander at 13:00 UTC and keep the status page updated until full remediation. Key actions: verify daily cron reroutes, confirm Azure completes RCA, collect post-incident metrics.
oncall-night: acknowledged. I'll own 13:00–19:00 UTC window. Please leave notes on runbook and escalate to eng-sre if we see >1% 5xx again.
alex_sre: adding runbook entries and links to packet captures in the case. Also saving the `infra-cli` roll forward commands used.
Azure Support (Tim): We've entered post-fix validation. We'll share a full RCA and affected CAC circuits list by EOD. Ticket AZ-INC-8172 will be updated with timeline and vendor actions.
statuspage-bot: Status page updated at 12:45 UTC: "Monitoring — Recovery in progress. Error rates improving following traffic reroutes and provider mitigation. Next update 13:00 UTC"
priya_oncall: closing note: current action items for handoff: (1) oncall-night monitor 5xx, (2) jane_vendor_mgr continue Azure coordination until RCA, (3) sara_support send tailored DMs to Tier 1 customers summarizing mitigation and next steps, (4) michael_pm prepare post-incident external summary.
jane_vendor_mgr: will coordinate with Azure account team and confirm communication timeline for partners. If Azure provides circuit-level RCA, we'll route to security/compliance for affected Private deployments.
oncall-night: taking over. Good job team.
